data.body: FORCE_CLOSE: close gate(s) bypassed by user approval — no completion/signature attestation was signed. Reason: "WON'T FIX (operator decision 2026-08-09). The plan's premise is disproven: the sequential per-criterion recovery loop it targets (completion_recovery.py:583) no longer exists, and the per-criterion fan-out design it proposes was already implemented, measured, and deliberately removed for exploding token/wall-clock cost — the same grounds this ticket argues from. No code will be written, so completion verification has nothing to verify. The surviving concern (the monolithic PRIMARY completion call as wall-clock critical path) is to be re-filed against the current batched architecture; rationale recorded in the closing comment.".
